elements.aside: Use Aside (ui/Aside): it needs a label, the name of the complementary content for screen readers.
elements.nav: Use Nav (ui/Nav): it needs a label, the name of the navigation for screen readers.
elements.main: Use Main (ui/Main): it gives the id of the skip link.
elements.section: Do not use section. Without a name it is not a landmark. With a name, each section is a landmark and makes noise in the landmark list of a screen reader. Use a div with a Heading. Use Aside, Nav or Main for a real landmark of the page.
elements.button: Use Button (ui/Button) for a button with the look of a button, or RawButton (ui/RawButton) for a button with its own look.
